test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 30 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which organisation conducted the study on background radiation levels in Kerala?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC)** is India's premier nuclear research facility located in **Trombay, Mumbai, Maharashtra**.
 
• It was established in **1954** and named after the renowned Indian nuclear physicist **Dr. Homi Jehangir Bhabha**.
 
• BARC conducts research in the fields of **nuclear science, engineering, and technology**.
 
• The organisation is known for its work on **nuclear reactors, isotope production, radiation technology, and nuclear medicine.**
 
• The study conducted by BARC on **background radiation levels** in Kerala is significant as Kerala has regions with **naturally high levels of radiation**, particularly due to the presence of **monazite sands** containing thorium.
 
• BARC's expertise in radiation research helps ensure **safety protocols** and aids in the understanding of radiation effects on humans and the environment.
 
• BARC collaborates with various national and international organisations for advancements in **nuclear technology**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Geological Survey of India (GSI)**__

 __
 
• The **Geological Survey of India** (GSI), established in **1851**, is one of India's oldest organisations.
 
• It is primarily involved in **geological research** and exploration of mineral resources.
 
• Its headquarters are located in **Kolkata, West Bengal**.
 
• GSI contributes to studies in **earth sciences** and provides geological data for various applications, but it does not specialise in radiation research.
 
 
 
• **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)**__
 __
 
• **ISRO**, founded in **1969**, is India's national space agency headquartered in **Bangalore, Karnataka**.
 
• ISRO focuses on **space exploration, satellite development, and launching systems**.
 
• Its areas of expertise include **remote sensing, space applications, and satellite communication**, but it does not engage in studies on radiation levels.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Environment**__
 
 
• The **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change** (MoEFCC) is a central government ministry in India.
 
• It is responsible for **environmental protection, conservation of forests, and climate change mitigation**.
 
• While it plays a role in formulating policies related to radiation effects on the environment, it does not conduct scientific studies directly like BARC does.
